headline: Executive order sets the order of officials who would act as Secretary of Defense if the Secretary cannot serve.
what_it_does: This order lists which Defense Department officials would step in to act as Secretary of Defense if the Secretary dies, resigns, or cannot do the job. No summary was provided, so the exact list of officials and any conditions are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: Some of them are named, in a set order, as the people who would temporarily act as Secretary of Defense.

when_it_takes_effect: 1996-04-24 (date signed; exact effective date not stated in the source)
